import json,sys,subprocess,hashlib,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import *
M=2**62-1
H=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
keys={'keys':['I','H','A']}
A=lambda pn,b,**kw:datagram(envelope('A',pn,b,**kw))
I=lambda pn,b,**kw:datagram(envelope('I',pn,b,**kw))
Hn=lambda pn,b,**kw:datagram(envelope('H',pn,b,**kw))
def F(t,*ns):return bytes([t])+b''.join(v(n) for n in ns)
def run(ts):
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=json.dumps({'traces':ts}).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return json.loads(p.stdout)['traces']
def statuses(r):return [x['status'] for x in r['packets']]
def okhash(r,i,b):assert r['packets'][i]['sha256']==H(b),(r['packets'][i],H(b))
# All supported types overlong body ints; canonical flags preserved.
parts=[(b'\0\1',b'\0\1'),
 (b'\x02'+b''.join(v(x,8) for x in [9,4,1,2,0,1]),F(2,9,4,1,2,0,1)),
 (b'\x03'+b''.join(v(x,4) for x in [20,0,0,20,3,4,5]),F(3,20,0,0,20,3,4,5)),
 (b'\x05'+v(1,8)+v(M),F(5,1,M)),
 (b'\x06'+v(2**32,8)+v(2,8)+b'zz',crypto(2**32,b'zz'))]
for flags in range(8):
 data=b'abc'
 sid=4*flags
 # lengthless stream must end this packet, so test each in a separate packet
 parts.append((bytes([8+flags])+v(sid,8)+(v(0,8) if flags&4 else b'')+(v(len(data),8) if flags&2 else b'')+data,
   stream(sid,0,data,fin=bool(flags&1),offset=bool(flags&4),length=bool(flags&2))))
parts += [(bytes([t])+b''.join(v(n,8) for n in ns),F(t,*ns)) for t,ns in [(0x10,[2**40]),(0x11,[0,2**40]),(0x12,[2**60]),(0x13,[2**60]),(0x14,[M]),(0x15,[2,M]),(0x16,[2**60]),(0x17,[2**60]),(0x19,[1])]]
parts += [(b'\x18'+v(2,8)+v(1,8)+b'\1\xdd'+b'\xff'*16,F(0x18,2,1)+b'\1\xdd'+b'\xff'*16), (b'\x1a12345678',b'\x1a12345678'),(b'\x1b12345678',b'\x1b12345678'),(b'\x30\xff\x00',b'\x30\xff\x00'),(b'\x31'+v(3,8)+b'abc',b'\x31\x03abc')]
ts=[trace([keys,A(0,a,spin=1,width=4)]) for a,b in parts]
rs=run(ts)
for (a,b),r in zip(parts,rs):
 assert statuses(r)==['OK'],(a,statuses(r))
 okhash(r,0,envelope('A',0,b))
# Canonical long tokens, length, PN, SCID; padding preserved; close truncates original suffix
body=b'\0\0'+F(0x1c,M,M,3)+b'abc'+b'\xff'
bcan=b'\0\0'+F(0x1c,M,M,3)+b'abc'
for lev in ['I','H','A']:
 r=run([trace([keys,datagram(envelope(lev,0,body,width=4,token=b'xx',scid=b'',length_width=8))])])[0]
 assert statuses(r)==['PEER_CLOSE']
 assert r['closed']['offset']==2
 okhash(r,0,envelope(lev,0,bcan,token=b'xx',scid=b''))
# rollback every type of state, including ACK/ECN, implicit opens, local retire, peer threshold, bytes, epoch.
prefix=b''.join([F(0x10,456),F(0x11,0,123),F(0x12,10),F(0x13,11),F(0x05,1,7),stream(4,2,b'data'),crypto(0,b'secret'),F(3,3,0,0,1,4,5,6),F(0x19,1),F(0x18,1,1)+b'\1\xdd'+b'1'*16])
r=run([trace([keys,A(0,stream(0,0,b'hi')),datagram(envelope('A',1,prefix+b'\xff',phase=1),auth=[1]),I(0,b'\1')])])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['OK','FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR','CLOSED']
assert r['key_epoch']==0 and r['epochs']==[{'epoch':0,'min':0,'max':0,'count':1}]
assert r['retire_prior_to']==0 and r['retired_local']==[] and r['peer_cids'][0]['id']=='cc'
assert r['used']==2 and r['opened']=={'bidi':1,'uni':0} and len(r['streams'])==1 and r['send_max_data']==0
assert r['crypto'][2]['unique']==0 and r['acknowledged'][2]['count']==0
# prefix commits on close
r=run([trace([keys,A(0,prefix+F(0x1d,0,0)+b'\xff')])])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['PEER_CLOSE']
assert r['used']==6 and r['opened']=={'bidi':2,'uni':0} and r['retired_local']==[[1,2]]
assert r['peer_cids']==[{'sequence':1,'id':'dd','token':'31'*16}]
assert r['crypto'][2]['unique']==6 and r['acknowledged'][2]['count']==2
# Stream final/reset/stop, equal overlaps, high-based credit, holes and sparse storage
es=[keys,A(0,stream(0,3,b'de')),A(1,stream(0,0,b'abcd')),A(2,F(5,0,44)+F(5,0,99)+F(0x11,0,999)),A(3,F(4,0,123,10)+F(4,0,321,10)),A(4,stream(0,0,b'XXXXX'))]
r=run([trace(es,connection=10,stream_credit=10)])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['OK']*5
s=r['streams'][0]
assert s=={'id':0,'high':10,'final':10,'reset':123,'stop':44,'send_max':999,'ranges':[[0,5]],'unique':5,'prefix':5,'sha256':H(b'abcde')},s
# flow/final/direction/count precedence even when off+data overflows
for sid,status in [(2,'STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR'),(3,'STREAM_STATE_ERROR'),(9,'STREAM_STATE_ERROR'),(0,'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR')]:
 r=run([trace([keys,A(0,stream(sid,M,b'xx'))],uni=0)])[0]
 assert statuses(r)==[status],(sid,statuses(r))
# Zero-byte stream advances credit to offset, whereas zero-byte crypto doesn't add any bytes
r=run([trace([keys,A(0,stream(0,10,b'')+crypto(M,b''))])])[0]
assert r['used']==10 and r['streams'][0]['unique']==0
# Epoch authentication window, duplicates before order, PN ordering
es=[keys,A(10,b'\1'),datagram(envelope('A',20,b'\1',phase=1),[1]),A(9,b'\1'),datagram(envelope('A',30,b'\1',phase=0),[2]),A(8,b'\1'),datagram(envelope('A',19,b'\1',phase=1),[1]),datagram(envelope('A',21,b'\1',phase=1),[1]),datagram(envelope('A',21,b'\1',phase=0),[2]),datagram(envelope('A',31,b'\1',phase=1),[1])]
r=run([trace(es)])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['OK','OK','OK','OK','AUTH','OK','OK','DUPLICATE','KEY_UPDATE_ERROR'],statuses(r)
assert r['epochs']==[{'epoch':0,'min':9,'max':10,'count':2},{'epoch':1,'min':19,'max':21,'count':3},{'epoch':2,'min':30,'max':30,'count':1}]
# Datagrams coalesce, BAD_HEADER still attempted after close, routing before key, PN-range priority.
es=[keys,datagram(envelope('I',0,F(0x19,0))+envelope('H',0,b'\1')+b'\x40',auth=[0,0,0]),{'keys':[]},datagram(envelope('I',1,b'\1')+b'\x80',[0]),datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\xff',cid=b'\xdd'),[0])]
r=run([trace(es)])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['PROTOCOL_VIOLATION','CLOSED','BAD_HEADER','CLOSED','BAD_HEADER','CLOSED'],statuses(r)
# PN at max with current expected max+1, overflow chosen from truncated low bytes, NO_KEY/CID first
es=[keys,A(0,b'\1'),A(M,b'\1',width=4),A(0,b'\1',cid=b'\xdd'),{'keys':[]},A(0,b'\1'),datagram(b'\x40',auth=[M])]
r=run([trace(es,received={'I':None,'H':None,'A':M})])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['PN_RANGE','DUPLICATE','DROP_CID','NO_KEY','BAD_HEADER'],statuses(r)
assert [p['pn'] for p in r['packets'][:4]]==[M+1,M,M+1,M+1]
# ACK union extremes and componentwise counters
es=[keys,A(0,F(3,M,0,0,M,10,2,3)),A(1,F(3,100,0,0,0,1,5,1))]
r=run([trace(es)])[0]
s=r['acknowledged'][2]
assert s=={'level':'A','count':M+1,'intervals':1,'prefix':M+1,'sha256':H((0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(M+1).to_bytes(8,'big')),'ecn':[10,5,3]},s
# Authentication/discard/epoch and reinstallation
es=[datagram(envelope('I',0,b'\xff'),[1]),{'keys':['A']},datagram(envelope('A',0,b'\1',phase=1),[1]),{'keys':[]},A(1,b'\xff'),keys,datagram(envelope('A',1,b'\1',phase=1),[1])]
r=run([trace(es)])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['AUTH','OK','NO_KEY','OK'] and r['key_epoch']==1
# Peer history retains retired ownership, rejects token conflicts even below threshold
new=lambda seq,rpt,cid,token=b'\0'*16:F(24,seq,rpt)+bytes([len(cid)])+cid+token
es=[keys,A(0,new(3,2,b'x')),A(1,new(1,0,b'y')),A(2,new(1,0,b'y')),A(3,new(4,4,b'z')),A(4,new(5,5,b'y'))]
r=run([trace(es,cids=2)])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['OK','OK','OK','OK','PROTOCOL_VIOLATION']
assert r['peer_cids']==[{'sequence':4,'id':'7a','token':'00'*16}] and r['retire_prior_to']==4
# Retirement before capacity and rollback over frame order
for final,sts,ids in [(new(2,1,b'y'),['OK'],['78','79']),(new(2,0,b'y')+new(3,3,b'z'),['CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR'],['cc'])]:
 r=run([trace([keys,A(0,new(1,0,b'x')+final)],cids=2)])[0]
 assert statuses(r)==sts
 assert [x['id'] for x in r['peer_cids']]==ids
# Local CID route state across coalesced packets, cannot retire its own destination.
es=[keys,datagram(envelope('I',0,b'\1')+envelope('A',0,F(25,1)),[0,0]),A(1,b'\xff',cid=b'\xbb'),A(1,F(25,0))]
r=run([trace(es)])[0]
assert statuses(r)==['OK','OK','DROP_CID','PROTOCOL_VIOLATION']
print('extended assertions passed')
